scientific_integrity: The finite-dimensional equality and upper bounds are proved by an exhaustive analytic partition into threshold intervals and winning-subset graph types. Four explicit equal-stake vectors attain the bounds. The bundled exact rational computations are replay checks, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the sharp two-parameter tail probability only for at most four positive Bernoulli stakes with common success probability no larger than the threshold. It does not address five or more active stakes, does not classify all optimal vectors, and parts of the formula are implied by published stronger parameter-restricted results.
title: Exact four-stake phase diagram for the Bernoulli averaging problem
